name: hook_iat_direct_syscall
description: Cross-process IAT hook of kernel32!SleepEx inside TestTarget.

extra.notes: Expected fingerprint: many small READVM_REMOTE events (PE header walk + import descriptor walk + name-string reads + IAT slot probe — typically 6-12 reads), 1x ALLOCVM_REMOTE (RWX trampoline, ~4KB), 1x WRITEVM_REMOTE (trampoline shellcode write, ~4KB), 1x PROTECTVM_REMOTE (IAT page RO->RW), 1x WRITEVM_REMOTE (pointer-sized slot overwrite: 8 bytes x64 / 4 bytes x86), 1x PROTECTVM_REMOTE (IAT page restore). No THREAD_CREATE_REMOTE. Distinguishing signal vs hook_inline: the small WRITEVM target address falls inside the target's IAT (parsed offline by analysis/pe_utils.py from DataDirectory[IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_IAT]), whereas an inline hook's small WRITEVM lands in a module's .text section.
